claims.value: Brazil remained a republic while its central executive changed during 1930. Washington Luís was deposed on 24 October; a three-member military junta governed until 3 November, when Getúlio Vargas became chief of the provisional government. Rio de Janeiro remained the capital. The 1934 constitution and 1937 Estado Novo belong to later phases.
